description: Flow Redirection and Induction in Steady State (FLORIS) Wind Plant Power Production Data Sets is a data set deposited in DOE National Library of the Rockies (NLR) Repository by its authors Dakota Ramos, Andrew Glaws. This dataset contains turbine- and plant-level power outputs for 252,500 cases of diverse wind plant layouts operating under a wide range of yawing and atmospheric conditions. The power outputs were computed using the Gaussian wake model in NREL's FLOw Redirection and Induction in Steady State (FLORIS) model, version 2.3.0. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 4 files. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
